message: It was not what I expected

Couldn’t tell by the small photo used in thumbnail, but when printed it is very obviously an AI image not an original artwork by an artist. Definitely a bummer when you wanted to support a small artist
The print came out pixelated for me.
Printed 11x14 at Walgreens. Image is not clear and pixelated. If this is not a concern then it looks decent framed and matted. The sale price was fair for what you get.
It’s okay. Not in love once it’s blown up.
Nice print, probably AI generated as Van Gogh never painted something like this.
